title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Crimes Involving Obscene and Pornographic Information on Mobile Phones
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Typical Cases of Crimes Involving Obscene and Pornographic Information on Mobile Phones

Case 1

Lin Junliang, Lin Haichang, and Fu Jinxiao — Producing, Selling, and Disseminating Obscene Materials for Profit

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Lin Junliang, male, Han Chinese, born March 8, 1985, farmer.

Defendant Lin Haichang, male, Han Chinese, born December 25, 1979, farmer.

Defendant Fu Jinxiao, male, Han Chinese, born July 28, 1987, farmer.

Starting from the end of January 2009, Defendant Lin Junliang leased network servers from Beijing Tuofeng Company and set up three mobile phone pornographic websites, which contained 5,389 obscene pornographic images and 490 obscene pornographic novels. By providing mobile phone advertising services to advertisers on the pornographic websites, he illegally profited RMB 29,690.14 in advertising fees paid by advertisers.

Since June 2008, Defendant Lin Haichang, in collusion with Defendant Fu Jinxiao, leased network servers from Beijing Tuofeng Company, jointly operated two mobile phone pornographic websites, and separately operated one mobile phone pornographic website. The websites contained 2,646 obscene pornographic images and 452 obscene pornographic novels. By providing advertising services to advertisers on the pornographic websites, they illegally profited RMB 52,435.50. Additionally, at the end of August 2008, Lin Haichang independently developed a website-building program for creating mobile phone websites and added pornographic novels to the program's database files, profiting RMB 45,044 by selling the program to others.

The two pornographic websites jointly operated by Defendant Fu Jinxiao and Defendant Lin Haichang contained 1,246 obscene pornographic images and 325 obscene pornographic novels. Fu Jinxiao was primarily responsible for daily maintenance and updating of the pornographic website content, illegally profiting RMB 58,050.31. Furthermore, although Fu Jinxiao knew that the mobile phone website-building program designed by Lin Haichang contained pornographic content, he still introduced others to purchase the program from Lin Haichang, earning an introduction fee of RMB 2,900.

In summary, Defendant Lin Junliang operated a total of three mobile phone pornographic websites, containing 5,389 obscene pornographic images and 490 obscene pornographic novels, illegally profiting RMB 29,690.14. Defendant Lin Haichang operated a total of three mobile phone pornographic websites, containing 2,646 obscene pornographic images and 452 obscene pornographic novels, and sold a mobile phone website-building program containing pornographic content, illegally profiting RMB 97,479.50 in total. Defendant Fu Jinxiao operated a total of two mobile phone pornographic websites, containing 1,246 obscene pornographic images and 325 obscene pornographic novels, illegally profiting RMB 60,950.31 in total.

(2) Judgment

The court found that Defendants Lin Junliang, Lin Haichang, and Fu Jinxiao, by operating mobile phone pornographic websites to provide mobile phone advertising services to advertisers, received fees paid by advertisers for illegal profit and disseminated obscene materials. The number of obscene pornographic images and novels disseminated by Lin Junliang reached the standard of particularly serious circumstances, while the numbers for Lin Haichang and Fu Jinxiao reached the standard of serious circumstances. Lin Haichang also profited by selling the mobile phone website-building program containing obscene pornographic content. The conduct of Lin Junliang and Fu Jinxiao constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit, and the conduct of Lin Haichang constituted the crime of producing, selling, and disseminating obscene materials for profit. In the joint crime of Lin Haichang and Fu Jinxiao, the two cooperated with a division of labor, each obtaining illegal benefits, and it was not appropriate to distinguish between principal and accessory offenders. Accordingly, in accordance with law, Defendant Lin Junliang was sentenced to ten years and three months in prison and fined RMB 170,000; Lin Haichang was sentenced to four years and three months in prison and fined RMB 120,000; and Fu Jinxiao was sentenced to three years in prison and fined RMB 100,000.

Case 2

Tang Xiaoming — Producing and Selling Obscene Materials for Profit

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Tang Xiaoming, male, Han Chinese, born November 9, 1980, self-employed.

In September 2008, Defendant Tang Xiaoming independently developed a website-building program for creating mobile phone WAP websites and added 95 obscene pornographic novels to the program. Tang Xiaoming then contacted others online and sold the program for prices ranging from RMB 1,500 to RMB 3,000 to persons including Shi Kaiyuan, Jin Chunchen, Miao Danjie, Zheng Bo, Wang Jun, Zheng Fanghua, Jiang Zheng, Hu Yangyang, Cao Xuejia, Sheng Nanyin, and Xue Jiale (all separately prosecuted) in the Jinhua area of Zhejiang Province for them to set up obscene pornographic websites, illegally profiting RMB 25,500.

(2) Judgment

The court found that Defendant Tang Xiaoming, with the purpose of profiting, produced a mobile phone website program containing obscene content and sold it to others for use in setting up pornographic websites. His conduct constituted the crime of producing and selling obscene materials for profit. Accordingly, in accordance with law, Defendant Tang Xiaoming was sentenced to one year and six months in prison and fined RMB 65,000.

Case 3

Luo Gang, Yang Tao, Ding Yi, and Yuan Yi — Disseminating Obscene Materials for Profit

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Luo Gang, male, Tujia ethnic group, born September 28, 1980, head of the Wireless Internet Business Department of Beijing Qingdian Wanwei Telecommunications Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant Yang Tao, male, Han Chinese, born March 23, 1978, product manager of the Wireless Internet Business Department of Beijing Qingdian Wanwei Telecommunications Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant Ding Yi, female, Han Chinese, born February 28, 1979, product editor of the Wireless Internet Business Department of Beijing Qingdian Wanwei Telecommunications Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant Yuan Yi, female, Han Chinese, born January 2, 1983, product editor of the Wireless Internet Business Department of Beijing Qingdian Wanwei Telecommunications Technology Co., Ltd.

The Wireless Internet Business Department under Beijing Qingdian Wanwei Telecommunications Technology Co., Ltd., in order to increase the click-through rate of mobile phone WAP services and boost the company's revenue, was instructed by Defendant Luo Gang to have Defendants Yang Tao, Ding Yi, and Yuan Yi disseminate obscene information through mobile phone WAP services within the company. Upon appraisal, from January 1, 2007, to May 9, 2007, a total of 28 obscene images were uploaded, with actual clicks numbering 82,973.

(2) Judgment

The court found that the Wireless Internet Business Department of Beijing Qingdian Wanwei Telecommunications Technology Co., Ltd., with the purpose of profiting the company, used the internet and mobile communication terminals to disseminate obscene electronic information, disrupting social order. The circumstances were serious. Luo Gang and Yang Tao, as department heads and product managers, instructed and directed subordinates to upload obscene electronic information, constituting the responsible persons in a unit crime. Ding Yi and Yuan Yi actively participated in using the internet to disseminate obscene electronic information, constituting the directly responsible persons in a unit crime. The conduct of all four constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. Accordingly, based on the roles each played in the unit crime, in accordance with law, Defendant Luo Gang was sentenced to five years in prison and fined RMB 5,000; Defendant Yang Tao was sentenced to four years in prison and fined RMB 4,000; Defendant Ding Yi was sentenced to three years in prison and fined RMB 3,000; and Defendant Yuan Yi was sentenced to three years in prison and fined RMB 3,000.

Case 4

Chen Guangming — Reproducing Obscene Materials for Profit

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Chen Guangming, male, Han Chinese, born July 30, 1985, farmer. In April 2007, he was sentenced by the Haidian District People's Court of Beijing to eleven months in prison and fined RMB 2,000 for the crime of purchasing stolen goods.

At approximately 10:00 p.m. on March 10, 2009, at a mobile phone shop operated by Defendant Chen Guangming at No. 70 Xiju Qianjie, Fengtai District, Beijing, he copied 35 obscene video files onto the memory card of Xiu Lixin's mobile phone for RMB 12 and was subsequently apprehended. Public security authorities seized 559 obscene video files from Chen Guangming's computer at the scene.

(2) Judgment

The court found that Defendant Chen Guangming, with the purpose of profiting, reproduced and sold obscene materials under serious circumstances, and his conduct constituted the crime of reproducing obscene materials for profit. He was also a recidivist and should be given a heavier punishment in accordance with law. Accordingly, in accordance with law, Defendant Chen Guangming was sentenced to three years and six months in prison and fined RMB 3,000; this was combined with the unpaid fine of RMB 2,000 from the previous sentence, and the combined sentence was decided to be three years and six months in prison and a fine of RMB 5,000.

Case 5

Yang Yong — Disseminating Obscene Materials for Profit

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Yang Yong, male, Han Chinese, born August 16, 1983, teacher.

Starting from July 2008, Defendant Yang Yong began promoting advertisements online to obtain advertising revenue. On November 30 of the same year, Yang Yong set up a mobile phone WAP using the internet, registered two domain names, and rented two server spaces in the United States at an annual rent of RMB 250. He then copied the source code from obscene WAP websites, modified it for his own websites, and uploaded it to the rented server space. In February 2009, Yang Yong set up sections on the aforementioned websites such as "Community," "Image Navigation," "Video Navigation," "Empire Cooperation Sites," and "Novel Navigation," and published a large number of obscene images, obscene videos, and other obscene electronic information. While disseminating obscene electronic information via the internet and mobile communication terminals, Yang Yong also joined advertising alliances, using sexually suggestive words as identifiers to attract viewers to click on advertising links placed on his self-built websites. The advertising operators paid Yang Yong over RMB 2,000 in advertising fees based on the number of clicks. Upon examination, as of 6:15 p.m. on June 3, 2009, one of the websites built by Yang Yong contained 275 obscene movies and 2,619 obscene images.

(2) Judgment

The court found that Defendant Yang Yong linked a large amount of obscene electronic information on his self-built websites and disseminated it through the internet and mobile communication networks. After joining advertising alliances, he linked advertising information to the same websites using sexually suggestive words as identifiers. By using obscene electronic information to increase advertising clicks, he achieved profit, and his conduct constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. The number of obscene movies and images linked on his websites reached the standard for serious circumstances. Accordingly, in accordance with law, Defendant Yang Yong was sentenced to four years in prison and fined RMB 3,000.

Case 6

Luo Liangyan and Luo Liding — Disseminating Obscene Materials for Profit

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Luo Liangyan, male, Han Chinese, born September 18, 1986, unemployed.

Defendant Luo Liding, male, Han Chinese, born August 28, 1987, unemployed.

In June or July 2008, Defendants Luo Liangyan and Luo Liding discussed setting up overseas mobile phone WAP obscene pornographic websites. Starting in August 2008, Luo Liangyan successively opened two overseas pornographic websites, uploading 700 of the over 1,000 pornographic images he had downloaded from the internet to the websites he created, and also uploaded two pornographic movies to the website backend via video links. Luo Liding also successively opened two overseas pornographic websites, using UBB codes to upload over 900 obscene pornographic images and novels found on the internet to the websites he created. The two defendants earned a total of RMB 20,000 in advertising fees by using the obscene electronic information.

(2) Judgment

The court found that Defendants Luo Liangyan and Luo Liding, with the purpose of profiting, used mobile phones to operate overseas obscene pornographic websites for profit, and their conduct constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. Given that the defendants were first-time offenders, had good attitudes of admitting guilt, and showed signs of remorse, a lighter punishment was imposed at the court's discretion. Accordingly, in accordance with law, Defendant Luo Liangyan was sentenced to six months in prison and fined RMB 3,000; Defendant Luo Liding was sentenced to six months in prison and fined RMB 3,000.
